english.note: This is the all-purpose noun for the area beside a road.
This is the all-purpose Cantonese noun for the side of a road or path.

examples.english: I’ll wait for you by the roadside.
examples.jyutping: ngo5 hai2 lou6 bin1 dang2 nei5

examples.english: I saw him standing by the wayside.
examples.jyutping: ngo5 gin3 dou2 keoi5 kei5 hai2 lou6 bin1
